shields.note: plasma shields always take the full (Normal) factor and are not reduced by unit armor

model.order: per hit: (weapon_damage + bonus*upgrade) - effective_armor (clamp >=0), then * size_factor%, then * hits
model.armor: subtracted PER HIT -> multi-hit weapons (Firebat 3, Zealot/Goliath-air 2) lose more to armor
model.independent_type: weapon_type 0 (Independent) and IgnoreArmor deal 100% to every size
model.unverified: the armor->factor ORDER and BW fixed-point rounding / minimum-damage floor are the documented model, to be confirmed by the engine diff; a fully-absorbed hit reads 0 here (BW has a small fixed-point floor)

attribution: damage-type x size mechanic and ability energy from the official StarCraft Compendium (classic.battle.net/scc); all numeric weapon/unit inputs are read from the game's own units.dat / weapons.dat by tools/dat.py
